note: Library-first: ONE new recipe (launch-thump — a muffled mortar/rocket push, deliberately NOT a war-film cannon crack, so it stays inside brand §10's calm register and carries the rest of the physics series). Everything else is the existing library. The DIEGETIC spine is the content, per the shorts adaptation: three cannon shots, three landings — those may run denser than long-form. Two build-and-drops carry the video: riser -> impact-deep-soft as the 7.67 km/s arc wraps the globe and CLOSES (the moment it fails to land), and impact-deep-soft + chime on the '=' — the equality that IS the video. Every at_s is taken from the REAL word times in vo.gen.ts, not the estimates: the shots leave the barrel on 'Fire' and on 'Seven.' (20.94), and the '=' lands on 'exactly' (38.58).
